title: Ex 1.3 #12 · {X : X ⊆ {3, 2, a} and |X| = 1}
prompt: Write the set $\{X : X \subseteq \{3, 2, a\} \text{ and } |X| = 1\}$ by listing its elements between braces.
answer_format: A set of sets between braces, like {∅, {1}, {1, 2}}. Spaces are optional.
hints: The elements of this set are themselves sets: subsets of {3, 2, a}.
Keep only the subsets with exactly 1 element(s).
solution: These are the subsets of {3, 2, a} with exactly 1 element(s).
